title: Paul McCartney live: JMA Wireless Dome, Syracuse | 2022
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the JMA Wireless Dome in Syracuse, New York, USA, on 4 June 2022.

The #PaulMcCartneyGotBack tour has arrived in Syracuse, New York! Who's coming to the show tonight?

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) June 4, 2022

It was the 12th show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney had previously performed at the Carrier Dome, as the venue was previously known, on 23 September 2017 during the One On One Tour.
